extraction.document_summary: DIRECT - AIA WHOLE LIFE COVER (II) is AIA’s Direct Purchase Insurance whole life plan that provides protection for life against Death and Terminal Illness up to age 100. If Death or Terminal Illness occurs, and also for Total and Permanent Disability (up to age 65), the insurer pays the insured amount together with any bonuses (if accrued). Premiums are designed to be affordable because you only pay up to age 70 or up to age 85, while the basic cover continues up to age 100. The policy may participate in annual non-guaranteed discretionary bonuses; once credited, annual bonuses form part of guaranteed benefits, and a potential one-off terminal bonus may be paid on claim, maturity, or surrender. A Critical Illness rider is optional, and it also lasts up to age 100.
quality_notes: Brochure provides clear product structure (whole life base + optional Critical Illness rider) and key payout events (Death/Terminal Illness/TPD up to age 65; maturity).
No numeric pricing, sum assured ranges, entry/maximum ages, waiting/free-look/grace periods, or underwriting type are stated in the document.
Bonus mechanics are described qualitatively but not with specific guaranteed rates; amounts are therefore not extracted.

policies.quick_summary: Whole life Direct Purchase Insurance cover for life against Death/Terminal Illness up to age 100, and TPD up to age 65. Pays insured amount plus any bonuses on Death/Terminal Illness/TPD (up to age 65). On maturity, insured amount plus bonuses are paid and policy terminates. Premiums are paid up to age 70 or 85 while cover continues to age 100; bonuses are non-guaranteed (annual discretionary + potential terminal bonus). Optional Critical Illness rider up to age 100 can be added via a Critical Illness rider (rider details not further specified in the flyer). For the basic plan, premiums are stated to remain unchanged.
coverage_scope: Total and Permanent Disability (up to age 65)
Maturity payout (insured amount plus bonuses) with policy termination
policies.coverage_term_description: Whole life protection against Death and Terminal Illness up to age 100; benefits for Death/Terminal Illness or Total and Permanent Disability (up to age 65).
policies.premium_payment_term_description: Pay premiums up to age 70 or up to age 85 (while receiving benefits from the basic plan up to age 100).
policies.bonuses_or_dividends: Discretionary non-guaranteed annual bonuses may be added every year; annual bonuses credited form part of guaranteed benefits. Also a potential one-off terminal bonus may be payable upon claim, maturity or surrender (if any).
policy_termination_events: Upon maturity, the insured amount plus any bonuses will be paid out and the policy will automatically terminate.
important_caveats: Annual bonuses and terminal bonus are non-guaranteed and depend on performance (for annual bonus/terminal bonus, if any).
The flyer states that precise terms and conditions, including exclusions, are specified in the policy contract.
Premiums are stated to remain unchanged for the basic plan.
